claims.text: The scale of the clearance at termination: 'On 10 June 1969, 13,187 contractor personnel were cleared on MOL and faced reassignment.'

claims.nodeLabel: Manned Orbiting Laboratory and the DORIAN / KH-10 reconnaissance payload
claims.sourceText: Spies in Space, NRO CSNR, May 2019, introduction and chapter 3, https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/GOVPUB-D-PURL-gpo123652/pdf/GOVPUB-D-PURL-gpo123652.pdf
claims.text: Seventeen officers were trained and none flew: 'Between 1965 and 1969, quietly and without fanfare, 17 non-NASA individuals were astronaut-trained in order to meet the reconnaissance needs of the United States.' The camera is dated and designated: 'In 1969, the Dorian camera system was designated KH-10 within the Talent-Keyhole community.'

claims.nodeLabel: Manned Orbiting Laboratory and the DORIAN / KH-10 reconnaissance payload
claims.sourceText: Spies in Space, NRO CSNR, May 2019, foreword, https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/GOVPUB-D-PURL-gpo123652/pdf/GOVPUB-D-PURL-gpo123652.pdf
claims.text: The declassification is dated and quantified in the NRO's own words: on 22 October 2015 the CSNR held a panel at the National Museum of the United States Air Force 'on the occasion of the NRO declassifying almost its entire collection of records on the Dorian program. There were over 850 documents with some 22,000 pages and 280 photographs.'

claims.nodeLabel: Manned Orbiting Laboratory and the DORIAN / KH-10 reconnaissance payload
claims.sourceText: Spies in Space: Reflections on National Reconnaissance and the Manned Orbiting Laboratory, NRO Center for the Study of National Reconnaissance, May 2019, foreword and chapter 3, https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/GOVPUB-D-PURL-gpo123652/pdf/GOVPUB-D-PURL-gpo123652.pdf
claims.text: The cover and the mission are described by the agency itself. The NRO's volume says MOL was 'open "white" world, but maintained a highly-classified "black" mission', with the reconnaissance mission 'codenamed Dorian in the BYEMAN security system', and its foreword calls Dorian 'a deeply classified program managed by the then darkly hidden agency of the Intelligence Community, the National Reconnaissance Office'.
